title: Two Clocks in Diffusion MLLMs: When Answers Stabilize Before Rationales Unfold
abstract: arXiv:2610.00953v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: An answer candidate in a masked diffusion MLLM can stabilize while its rationale is still unfolding. We distinguish retrospective stabilization of the logged candidate from token commitment, and examine these two clocks relative to rationale generation. Analyzing our results across three visual question-answering benchmarks, we find that 89.4-98.1% of the rationale-side canvas remains unwritten at stabilization in single-block, EOS-suppressed LaViDa runs. On V*Bench, reducing block length from 128 to 8 changes this fraction from 89.4% to 1.7%, together with answer coverage and the eligible observation window. Under EOS-enabled prompting, direct instructions improve Nemotron's overall accuracy by 15.0 and 19.5 percentage points on M3CoT and ScienceQA, but reduce LaViDa/V*Bench accuracy by 11.0 points. A symmetric decomposition associates the larger absolute component of each change with coverage rather than conditional accuracy. Matched

translated_title: 扩散多模态大语言模型中的两个时钟：当答案在推理依据展开之前便已稳定
translated_abstract: 在掩码扩散多模态大语言模型中，答案候选可能在推理依据仍在展开的过程中就已经稳定。我们区分了被记录候选的回溯性稳定与词元提交，并考察这两个时钟相对于推理依据生成的关系。通过分析三个视觉问答基准上的结果，我们发现，在单块、抑制EOS的LaViDa运行中，答案稳定时推理依据一侧的画布仍有89.4%—98.1%未被书写。在V*Bench上，将块长度从128缩短至8，会使这一比例从89.4%变为1.7%，同时答案覆盖率和符合条件的观察窗口也随之改变。在启用EOS的提示下，直接指令使Nemotron在M3CoT和ScienceQA上的总体准确率分别提升15.0和19.5个百分点，但使LaViDa在V*Bench上的准确率下降11.0个百分点。对称分解表明，每次变化中较大的绝对分量源于覆盖率而非条件准确率。
tldr: 扩散多模态大语言模型中答案稳定与推理依据生成分属两个不同时钟——答案常在推理依据大部分尚未写出时便已回溯性稳定，且块长度与EOS提示设置会显著改变这种关系及答案覆盖率。
en_tdlr: In masked diffusion MLLMs, answer stabilization and rationale unfolding follow two distinct clocks—answers often stabilize retrospectively while most of the rationale remains unwritten, and block length and EOS prompting substantially reshape this relationship along with answer coverage.
